subject: BurnoutAholics stats
author: Xandu
body:
Since we have been up and running for a year now I thought it would be cool to give you some stats for the last 11 months (we didn't turn stats on until June 2007).

  • Total number of page view: 535.683
  • Total number of unique hits: 112.653
  • Most busy month: Feb. 2008
  • Most popular OS platform: Microsoft Windows (92%)
  • We have had visitors from 127 different countries.
  • Blog entries: 445
  • News stories: 167
  • Comments: 2558
  • Private messages: 1661
  • New BurnoutAholics: 559
  • Poll votes: 5240
  • Polls: 58

-- The Creator --

subject: You have a cabbage patch doll...
author: SUFFUR
body:
So you know how to rear your young if you have any... and remind you Sunday dinners are not fun but murder of generations of your family...

there is a thin line between fruits and vegatables, and you are a lost pea fallen off the plate, to be found dehydrated in the corner of the room, to be revived by the Resistance to fight back, Peas in a pod and all that, Fight and united for brothers mashed  from another pod, but still a bunch of vegatables, that gets their wounds salted... and peppered in my case...😈

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out? But flick a pea, and save one of drunks extented family.

Tipsey ( E or no E that is the question) snorting can be seen as rude with out a hanky, so stop laughing and eat your McAnus, quietly...😉

Oh and thank you all for the shock theropy, not that it did any good... now where is a plug socket and that glass of water, no kids don't try that at home unless you have an audience that will laugh, till you pass out and then they might call an ambulance, or not...

subject: well done guys
author: drunknnumpty
body:
Big thank you for Xan and Zom for being the most gracious of hosts for the weekend.. was great fun and a nice break away from home..

nice to see that the site has remained popular and long may it continue.. while there is a burnout game out there I will be playing and writing on this site..

will have to have a rematch at the crazy golf next time i'm down.. give Xan a chance to beat me 😉

Also have to mention the comedy of Suffur who had us all in stiches all weekend.. and it was nice to see my family in passing.. lol..

theres a thin line between genius and insanity... i think i've fallen off...
